class UIStyles:
    def __init__(self):
        B = MOD_BITS["BOLD"]
        D = MOD_BITS["DIM"]
        I = MOD_BITS["ITALIC"]
        C = lambda n: Color("named", render.NAMED_COLORS[n])
        RGB = lambda h: parse_color(h)
        RST = Color("reset")
        self.input_block_active = Style(fg=C("LightYellow"))
        self.input_block_invalid = Style(fg=C("LightRed"))
        self.input_cursor_active = Style(fg=C("Black"), bg=C("LightYellow"))
        self.input_cursor_invalid = Style(fg=C("Black"), bg=C("LightRed"))
        self.list_item_selected = Style(fg=C("LightYellow"), mods=B)
        self.list_highlight_active = Style(fg=C("Black"), bg=C("LightGreen"))
        self.list_highlight_inactive = Style(fg=C("Black"), bg=C("LightBlue"))
        self.jl_block_active = Style(fg=RST, mods=B)
        self.jl_block_inactive = Style(fg=RGB("#AAAAC8"))
        self.jl_block_multi_select = Style(fg=C("Yellow"), mods=B | I)
        self.jl_highlight_active = Style(fg=C("Black"), bg=C("LightGreen"), mods=B)
        self.jl_highlight_inactive = Style(fg=C("Black"), bg=C("LightBlue"), mods=B)
        self.jl_title_active = Style(fg=RST, mods=B)
        self.jl_title_inactive = Style(fg=RGB("#AAAAC8"), mods=B)
        self.jl_title_selected = Style(fg=C("Yellow"), mods=B)
        self.jl_date_priority = Style(fg=C("LightBlue"))
        self.jl_tags_default = Style(fg=C("LightCyan"), mods=D)
        self.ed_block_insert = Style(fg=C("LightGreen"), mods=B)
        self.ed_block_visual = Style(fg=C("Blue"), mods=B)
        self.ed_block_normal_active = Style(fg=RST, mods=B)
        self.ed_block_normal_inactive = Style(fg=RGB("#AAAAC8"))
        self.ed_cursor_normal = Style(fg=C("Black"), bg=C("White"))
        self.ed_cursor_insert = Style(fg=C("Black"), bg=C("LightGreen"))
        self.ed_cursor_visual = Style(fg=C("Black"), bg=C("Blue"))
        self.ed_selection = Style(fg=C("Black"), bg=C("White"))
        self.msg_error = C("LightRed")
        self.msg_warning = C("Yellow")
        self.msg_info = C("LightGreen")
        self.msg_question = C("LightBlue")


# --------------------------------------------------------------- editor -----

class Editor:
    """A small vim-like multi-line text editor."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.lines = [""]
        self.cx = 0          # cursor column (char index)
        self.cy = 0          # cursor line
        self.mode = "normal"  # normal | insert | visual
        self.dirty = False
        self.scroll_y = 0
        self.scroll_x = 0
        self.visual_anchor = None
        self.clipboard = ""
        self.undo_stack = []
        self.redo_stack = []

    def set_content(self, text):
        self.lines = text.split("\n")
        self.cx = 0
        self.cy = 0
        self.dirty = False
        self.scroll_y = 0
        self.scroll_x = 0
        self.mode = "normal"
        self.undo_stack = []
        self.redo_stack = []

    def content(self):
        return "\n".join(self.lines)

    def cursor_to_end(self):
        self.cy = len(self.lines) - 1
        self.cx = len(self.lines[self.cy])

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    def _snapshot(self):
        self.undo_stack.append((list(self.lines), self.cx, self.cy))
        self.redo_stack = []

    def undo(self):
        if self.undo_stack:
            self.redo_stack.append((list(self.lines), self.cx, self.cy))
            self.lines, self.cx, self.cy = self.undo_stack.pop()
            self.dirty = True

    def redo(self):
        if self.redo_stack:
            self.undo_stack.append((list(self.lines), self.cx, self.cy))
            self.lines, self.cx, self.cy = self.redo_stack.pop()
            self.dirty = True

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    def clamp(self):
        self.cy = max(0, min(self.cy, len(self.lines) - 1))
        line = self.lines[self.cy]
        maxx = len(line) if self.mode == "insert" else max(0, len(line) - 1)
        if line == "" and self.mode != "insert":
            maxx = 0
        self.cx = max(0, min(self.cx, maxx))

    def insert_char(self, ch):
        self._snapshot()
        line = self.lines[self.cy]
        self.lines[self.cy] = line[:self.cx] + ch + line[self.cx:]
        self.cx += len(ch)
        self.dirty = True

    def insert_newline(self):
        self._snapshot()
        line = self.lines[self.cy]
        self.lines[self.cy] = line[:self.cx]
        self.lines.insert(self.cy + 1, line[self.cx:])
        self.cy += 1
        self.cx = 0
        self.dirty = True

    def backspace(self):
        if self.cx == 0 and self.cy == 0:
            return
        self._snapshot()
        if self.cx > 0:
            line = self.lines[self.cy]
            self.lines[self.cy] = line[:self.cx - 1] + line[self.cx:]
            self.cx -= 1
        else:
            prev = self.lines[self.cy - 1]
            self.cx = len(prev)
            self.lines[self.cy - 1] = prev + self.lines[self.cy]
            del self.lines[self.cy]
            self.cy -= 1
        self.dirty = True

    def delete_char(self):
        line = self.lines[self.cy]
        if self.cx < len(line):
            self._snapshot()
            self.lines[self.cy] = line[:self.cx] + line[self.cx + 1:]
            self.dirty = True
        elif self.cy < len(self.lines) - 1:
            self._snapshot()
            self.lines[self.cy] = line + self.lines[self.cy + 1]
            del self.lines[self.cy + 1]
            self.dirty = True

    def move_left(self):
        if self.cx > 0:
            self.cx -= 1

    def move_right(self):
        line = self.lines[self.cy]
        limit = len(line) if self.mode == "insert" else max(0, len(line) - 1)
        if self.cx < limit:
            self.cx += 1

    def move_up(self):
        if self.cy > 0:
            self.cy -= 1
            self.clamp()

    def move_down(self):
        if self.cy < len(self.lines) - 1:
            self.cy += 1
            self.clamp()

    def word_forward(self):
        line = self.lines[self.cy]
        i = self.cx
        n = len(line)
        while i < n and not line[i].isalnum():
            i += 1
        while i < n and line[i].isalnum():
            i += 1
        if i >= n and self.cy < len(self.lines) - 1:
            self.cy += 1
            self.cx = 0
        else:
            self.cx = min(i, max(0, n - 1)) if self.mode != "insert" else i
        self.clamp()

    def word_backward(self):
        line = self.lines[self.cy]
        i = self.cx
        if i == 0 and self.cy > 0:
            self.cy -= 1
            self.cx = max(0, len(self.lines[self.cy]) - 1)
            return
        i = max(0, i - 1)
        while i > 0 and not line[i].isalnum():
            i -= 1
        while i > 0 and line[i - 1].isalnum():
            i -= 1
        self.cx = i

    def delete_word_forward(self):
        line = self.lines[self.cy]
        i = self.cx
        n = len(line)
        j = i
        while j < n and not line[j].isalnum():
            j += 1
        while j < n and line[j].isalnum():
            j += 1
        if j > i:
            self._snapshot()
            self.lines[self.cy] = line[:i] + line[j:]
            self.dirty = True

    def delete_word_backward(self):
        line = self.lines[self.cy]
        i = self.cx
        j = i
        while j > 0 and not line[j - 1].isalnum():
            j -= 1
        while j > 0 and line[j - 1].isalnum():
            j -= 1
        if j < i:
            self._snapshot()
            self.lines[self.cy] = line[:j] + line[i:]
            self.cx = j
            self.dirty = True

    # visual mode -------------------------------------------------
    def visual_range(self):
        if self.visual_anchor is None:
            return None
        a = self.visual_anchor
        b = (self.cx, self.cy)
        if a > b:
            a, b = b, a
        return a, b

    def visual_delete(self, yank_only=False, change=False):
        rng = self.visual_range()
        if rng is None:
            return
        (ax, ay), (bx, by) = rng
        self._snapshot()
        if ay == by:
            line = self.lines[ay]
            cut = line[ax:bx + 1]
            if not yank_only:
                self.lines[ay] = line[:ax] + line[bx + 1:]
        else:
            first = self.lines[ay][:ax]
            last = self.lines[by][bx + 1:]
            cut = "\n".join([self.lines[ay][ax:]] + self.lines[ay + 1:by] + [self.lines[by][:bx + 1]])
            if not yank_only:
                self.lines[ay:by + 1] = [first + last]
        self.clipboard = cut
        if not yank_only:
            self.dirty = True
            self.cx, self.cy = ax, ay
            self.clamp()
        self.mode = "insert" if change else "normal"
        self.visual_anchor = None

    def paste(self):
        if not self.clipboard:
            return
        self._snapshot()
        line = self.lines[self.cy]
        at = min(self.cx + 1, len(line))
        self.lines[self.cy] = line[:at] + self.clipboard + line[at:]
        self.cx = at + len(self.clipboard) - 1
        self.dirty = True
        self.clamp()

124	## 2. Config file parsing (`-c DIR`, file `config.toml`)
125	
126	Test rig: `printf '<cfg>' > /tmp/cfg/config.toml; env -i HOME=/tmp/homeE PATH=/usr/bin:/bin /workspace/executable -c /tmp/cfg print-config`
127	
128	All config parse failures go to **stderr**, print nothing to stdout, and exit **1**. Prefix is always
129	`Error: Failed to read configuration file. Error infos: ` followed by the TOML error.

131	### backend_type — case-sensitive enum, exactly `Json` or `Sqlite`
132	
133	```

136	  |

138	  |                ^^^^^^
139	unknown variant `json`, expected `Json` or `Sqlite`
140	```
141	Same shape for `"SQLITE"` and `"XML"`. `"Json"` and `"Sqlite"` accepted (EXIT=0).
142

144	
145	```
146	datum_visibility = "Show"   → EXIT=1

148	datum_visibility = "none"   → EXIT=1 (same message, `none`)
149	datum_visibility = "hidden" → EXIT=1 (same message, `hidden`)
150	datum_visibility = "empty_line" → EXIT=0, printed back as datum_visibility = "empty_line"

458	## 5. Logging
459	
460	### Without `-v`
461	
462	Default log file is **not created**: after `rm -rf ~/.cache`, a plain UI run + quit left
463	`$HOME/.cache/tui-journal/` nonexistent. (A log file seen earlier at first run was created under `-v`-less
464	conditions only when something was actually logged; in a clean open/quit cycle nothing is written/created.)
465	
466	### With `-l /tmp/homeE/log.txt` and increasing verbosity (UI run: open, optionally create entry, quit)
467	
468	| flags | result |
469	|---|---|
470	| `-v`  | log file created, **0 bytes / 0 lines** (even after creating an entry in the UI) |
471	| `-vv` | log file created, **0 bytes / 0 lines** |
472	| `-vvv` | TRACE level, 4 lines for a plain open/quit |
473	| `-vvvv` | accepted (no clap error despite "up to 3 times"), level stays TRACE |
474	
475	`-vvv` log contents (timestamps are local HH:MM:SS, no date):
476	
477	```
478	01:02:08 [TRACE] (1) tjournal::logging: [src/logging.rs:38] Log initialized with level: TRACE
479	01:02:08 [TRACE] (1) tjournal::app: [src/app/mod.rs:126] Loading entries
480	01:02:08 [TRACE] (1) mio::poll: [/usr/local/cargo/registry/src/index.crates.io-1949cf8c6b5b557f/mio-1.0.4/src/poll.rs:571] registering event source with poller: token=Token(0), interests=READABLE
481	01:02:08 [TRACE] (1) mio::poll: [/usr/local/cargo/registry/src/index.crates.io-1949cf8c6b5b557f/mio-1.0.4/src/poll.rs:571] registering event source with poller: token=Token(1), interests=READABLE
482	```
483	
484	Format: `HH:MM:SS [LEVEL] (N) module::path: [source/file.rs:line] message` — `(1)` appears to be a thread id;
485	dependency modules (e.g. `mio`) log with their cargo-registry path at TRACE. App crate name is `tjournal`.
486	So the mapping behaves like: (none)=off, `-v`=ERROR, `-vv`=WARN, `-vvv`=TRACE (observed: nothing logged at
487	-v/-vv in normal use; exact level names not directly printed except at TRACE init line).

112	- Dirty state: ` *` suffix in the Content block title (all modes), e.g. `Content - EDIT *`.
113	- Save with `s` (NORMAL) or `Ctrl-s` (EDIT; presumably also NORMAL):
114	  - title ` *` disappears immediately;
115	  - the JSON back-end file is rewritten at once, e.g.
116	    ```json
117	    [{"id":0,"date":"2026-08-09T00:00:00Z","title":"First Entry","content":"one two three\nfour five six\nseven eight nineX","tags":[],"priority":null}]
118	    ```
119	    (content newlines stored as `\n` escapes);
120	  - **no toast/status message** or other visual confirmation observed.
121	- Discard with `Ctrl-q`: shows a centered confirmation popup with **blue border** (`38;5;12`):
122	  ```
123	  ┌──────────────────────────────…┐
124	  │   Do you want to discard all unsaved changes?   │
125	  │         (Y)es , (N)o          │
126	  └──────────────────────────────…┘
127	  ```
128	  `y` reverts the editor content to the last saved state and clears the ` *`. (`n` path obvious,
129	  not explicitly captured.)
